svg.title: Design reference - source page 84
svg.desc: YANQING WINTER OLYMPIC VILLAGE HOT SPRINGS Concept Plan and Pool Programme PLAN KEY 01 Entrance 02 Children’s play pool 03 Source-water display pool 04 Landscape seating 05 Natural stone pool 06 Fruit bath 07 Milk bath 08 Sea salt bath 09 Chinese herbal bath 10 Floral bath 11 Red wine bath 12 Source-water bath 13 Baijiu bath 14 Rest deck 15 Hydrotherapy pool with equipment The design starts with the natural landscape and ecological protection. Buildings and planting form a modern mountain settlement around the springs, in keeping with the Winter Olympics’ approach to venues in a forested mountain setting. The design coordinates structures, materials and equipment to support long-term environmental goals while drawing on Chinese traditions of building in mountain landscapes. YUANWANG / HOT SPRING DESIGN 084 / 118 Drawing-label key: 入口 = entrance; 出口 = exit; 前厅/接待 = lobby/reception; 更衣室 = changing room; 男更衣 = men's changing; 女更衣 = women's changing; 淋浴 = showers; 卫生间 = WC; 泳池 = swimming pool; 儿童池 = children's pool; 泡池 = bathing pool; 私汤 = private bath; 水疗 = hydrotherapy; 水吧 = poolside bar; 休息区 = rest area; 设备间/机房 = plant room; 储藏 = store; 办公 = office; 餐厅 = restaurant; 楼梯 = stairs; 电梯 = lift; 水景 = water feature; 绿地 = landscaped area; 总平面图 = master plan; 首层/一层 = ground floor; 二层 = first floor; 剖面图 = section; 图例 = legend. Original English numbered legends are retained.
